entry.title: New: dsh-tool-vision
entry.summary: Adds an image_describe tool backed by the DashScope OpenAI-compatible vision API; on text-only sessions, pasted images are stored as local paths for the model and rendered inline in the chat transcript. Exact install spec: github:wanshichenguang/dsh-tool-vision. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
